Read them daily — even if you don't believe them at first. Put on bathroom mirror so you see them every morning.

**Status 2026-05-09 (Session 3)**: Final list of 7 affirmations confirmed with Bernard:
1. I am worthy of love

3. I take care of myself
4. I am resilient
5. I am the master of my attention
6. I can only control myself
7. I am more than the moments I experience

Bernard said 7 is fine (better than 10 if it sticks). Acceptance & Commitment Therapy frame: human cognition is not linear (sine wave) — failing an affirmation is a moment, not an identity. Don't spiral when you fall short.
